items.title: Doué gravement blessé: combien de temps faut-il pour reprendre après une rupture du ligament croisé du genou?
items.description: Victime d'une rupture du ligament croisé antérieur du genou droit ce samedi à Nice, Désiré Doué va manquer de très longs mois de compétition. Si le PSG n'a pas donné de date d'indisponibilité, l'international français pourrait ne plus rejouer de la saison, à en croire les délais de récupération des footballeurs.
items.excerpt: Les images laissaient peu de doutes, et le résultat a été confirmé ce dimanche matin par le PSG: Désiré Doué, gravement blessé la veille lors de la rencontre de Ligue 1 à Nice, souffre d'une rupture du ligament croisé antérieur du genou droit. L'international français subira une intervention chirurgicale d'ici à la fin du mois, a ajouté le PSG dans un court communiqué, sans préciser sa durée d'indisponibilité qui devrait se compter en mois. C'est un nouveau coup dur pour Luis Enrique, déjà privé de Khvicha Kvaratskhelia pour la même blessure. L'entourage de "Kvara" avait alors évalué son absen

items.title: Virgil van Dijk sets records with 50th consecutive Premier League start for Liverpool
items.excerpt: Virgil van Dijk set multiple records by starting for Liverpool against Manchester United on Sunday. The centre-back was in the Reds’ Premier League XI for the 50th consecutive game. Aged 35 years and 137 days, Van Dijk is the oldest outfield player ever to achieve that feat for a single club – overtaking Kevin Davies at Bolton Wanderers, aged 34 years and 175 days when he totalled 67. It is the fourth time in his career that Van Dijk has played 50 matches in a row in the Premier League. In that regard, the Dutchman equalled the record for an outfield player set by Sylvain Distin.

items.title: Real Madrid: "Jouer avec le meilleur joueur du monde, c'est incroyable", Espi fait l'éloge de Mbappé
items.description: Après avoir donné le but de la victoire au Real Madrid en fin de match contre le Celta Vigo (2-1), Carlos Espi n'a pas hésité à encenser Kylian Mbappé malgré le pénalty raté de l'attaquant français.
items.excerpt: Kylian Mbappé et Carlos Espi ont pris part au même match ce samedi mais ont chacun vécu une soirée totalement différente. Face au Celta Vigo, le Real Madrid s'est fait peur en encaissant le premier but dès la 6e minute de jeu au Santiago Bernabéu. Titulaire au coup d'envoi, le capitaine de l'équipe de France est passé à côté de sa première période en ratant notamment un pénalty (38e) qui aurait pu permettre à son équipe d'égaliser avant de rentrer aux vestiaires. L'attaquant français a été un peu plus remuant et surtout plus juste en seconde mi-temps en délivrant une passe décisive à Jude Bell

items.title: César Azpilicueta: ‘At Chelsea a draw was a catastrophe – if you can’t perform, you’re out’
items.description: Former defender reflects on his record-breaking longevity, kicking Eden Hazard in training, and life after retirement César Azpilicueta looks well. César Azpilicueta always looks well – “ah, Captain Handsome,” one Chelsea fan says when told who’s turning up – but today especially, smiling in the sunshine. items.title: Raya set to have scan on injury - how much would Arsenal miss him?
items.description: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya is set to have a scan on his shoulder after going off injured during Saturday's 2-2 draw with Newcastle.
items.excerpt: Injuries are never good news, but Arsenal's latest one to first-choice goalkeeper David Raya has come in the worst possible position. items.excerpt: Barcelona came back from two goals behind to beat Villarreal 3-2 at home on Sunday and restore their three-point lead at the top of La Liga. Two goals inside seven minutes from Tajon Buchanan and Tani Oluwaseyi gave Villarreal a commanding lead at Camp Nou, and things got worse for Barça when winger Lamine Yamal missed a first-half penalty. The Catalan giants fought back in style, striking three times in an 11-minute second-half spell to claim victory. Gerard Martín and Fermín López pulled Barça level before Pau Navarro’s own goal gave them victory. Barca have now won four consecutive matches

items.title: From conceding seven to Hull heroics - how Tzolakis recovered to defy Brighton
items.description: Nine days after playing for Greece in a nightmare 7-0 loss, keeper Konstantinos Tzolakis plays a pivotal role in Hull's Premier League win against Brighton.
items.excerpt: Hull boss Sergej Jakirovic used one word to describe the performance of his goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis in Sunday's 2-0 Premier League win against Brighton. "Especially after the international break, which was very difficult for him." Tzolakis' previous outing had been for Greece against the Netherlands in the Uefa Nations League, where he and his side were humbled 7-0 by the hosts in Amsterdam. Nine days later, his contribution to the Tigers' first league victory since 29 August was every bit as important as that of striker Oli McBurnie, who netted both goals in second-half stoppage time

items.title: Zalewski, sei mesi da nerazzurro, tra l’assist nel derby e la finale di Champions. Poi arrivò l'Atalanta...
items.description: Arrivato a gennaio in prestito, il polacco lasciò subito il segno con l’assist a De Vrij nel derby. L'Inter lo prese con il riscatto per 6,5 milioni, i bergamaschi ne offrirono 17. E lo presero
items.excerpt: Sei mesi a Milano, una finale di Champions, il prezioso assist nel derby e una plusvalenza come ultimo regalo all’Inter dopo un periodo in nerazzurro breve ma intenso: in quanti si ricordano di Zalewski in campo con la maglia dell’Inter la sera del 5-0 del Psg? Pochi, probabilmente, e tutti giustificati: quella è una notte che il mondo nerazzurro intende soltanto cancellare dalla memoria. Eppure c'era anche lui, l’ex Roma oggi all’Atalanta che questa sera ritroverà i nerazzurri da avversario: a Monaco di Baviera subentrò al 54' al posto di Dimarco, venne subito ammonito e confezionò una serata
